Fact.MissDistance: {km} km from Earth, {lunar} times the Moon's distance

Learned.Asteroid: {name} passed {km} km from Earth, {lunar} times the Moon's distance. Each tracked pass like this one refines the asteroid's orbit.
Learned.Storm: A Kp {kp} storm. Measurements like these feed the forecasts that protect satellites and power grids.
Learned.Method.Transit: {name} dims its star a little each time it crosses in front. The depth of the dip gives the planet's size.
Learned.Method.RadialVelocity: {name} tugs its star back and forth. The size of the wobble gives the planet's mass.
Learned.Method.Imaging: {name} was photographed directly, which so far works only for large, young planets far from their stars.
Learned.Method.Microlensing: {name} was found when its star's gravity briefly magnified the light of a more distant star.
